generate_svg_elements: generate SVG elements from an ASE DrawGroup containing atoms, bonds, cell lines, and miller planes
create_svg_document: create a full SVG document from a list of SVG elements with a specified size and background color
concatenate_svgs: concatenate multiple SVGs into a grid layout with optional labels and scaling
svg_to_pdf: convert an SVG object or string to a PDF drawing using reportlab and svglib
svg_to_pil: convert an SVG object or string to a PIL Image using cairosvg
